scoring_justification: The verifier cannot re-run the full equilibrium solver, so recompute from raw artifacts is infeasible. Using T0 result-level compare against the paper’s reported values with reasonable tolerances.

outputs.description: Mole fractions of alkali species (KOH, K, KO; NaOH, Na, NaO) for the two 1900 K moist-air equilibrium calculations. Compared to the paper's tabulated values within a relative tolerance.

Molar percentage of potassium or sodium present as gaseous hydroxide for all five conditions, plus the temperature reduction from the pure-air baseline at the enthalpy addition that raises pure moist air to approximately 1800 K (for the 1900 K K2CO3 and Na2CO3 cases). The baseline temperature is 1800 K; the reduction is the difference between that baseline temperature and the temperature of the additive mixture at the same enthalpy. Values for other cases are ignored. Compared to the paper's reported values within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The task covers equilibrium speciation, derived hydroxide percentages, and the temperature reductions at the 1800 K baseline, all reproducible with the same chemical equilibrium solver. The enthalpy-temperature curves are generated as a process step; the reductions are scored within the hydroxide_percentages.csv file.

checks.description: Compare each mole fraction of the alkali species to the paper's tabulated values with 10% relative tolerance.
Compare each hydroxide percentage to the paper's reported values with tolerance = max(10% relative, 3 percentage points absolute).
